decisions.topic: Booking cancellation cutoff and cargo duty
decisions.proposal: Customer can only request cancellation; Booking module validates cutoff and owner approval; after Trip.STARTED route into interruption/recovery, never direct cancellation
decisions.failSafe: No automatic fee or resource release from customer input
checks: penalty and refund are authorized versioned ledger facts

decisions.proposal: Commercial owns one private review per verified eligible completed service with customer grant; no public rating, self-review or review after partial/disputed unresolved service
decisions.failSafe: Review submit disabled or pending eligibility until policy accepted

decisions.failSafe: Unverified or expired registry items cannot support CONFIRMED booking
checks: one resource cannot overlap across branches
hold expiry versus confirmation guarded by PG

decisions.topic: Commercial contract costing and external accounting boundary
decisions.proposal: KERUENIX owns versioned sell/buy price, cost estimate, margin and opaque external accounting document reference only. External business/accounting systems issue invoices/ESF, receive payments, perform reconciliation and refunds. Online EDS signs legal documents but is not a payment facility.
decisions.failSafe: No internal invoice issuance, PAID/SETTLED/REFUNDED state, banking connection, PaymentAllocation, tax ESF generation or payment endpoint.
checks: commercial price version and currency precise
external accounting document reference is not payment proof
no bank/ERP settlement adapters or payment tables
no fiscal invoice/ESF claiming KERUENIX as issuer

decisions.proposal: Infrastructure EvidenceBlobGateway stages/verifies original bytes; Execution commits ProofReceipt+custody+Outbox; Documents consumes exported event and publishes immutable versioned package, orphan blob reconcile
decisions.failSafe: Unverified object URL/empty bytes never proves pickup/POD

apiConventions.pagination: offset + stable tie-breaker and scope-before-count for RFQ; cursor+signed scope for immutable timeline
apiConventions.errors: RFC9457 stable KX-* and generated requestId
apiConventions.idempotency: key bound to verified principal+tenant+resource+canonical payload hash, TTL/history contract must be agreed
apiConventions.requestContext: No tenantId/trustedRole/approvalState/paid from body; verified context from auth
apiConventions.security: tenant RLS plus account-grant predicate, not tenant RLS alone
apiConventions.writes: aggregate version guard + audit + Outbox in same PG transaction
